summary: This workflow (a macro, which is a reusable Alteryx sub-process) filters records to the 'Care Navigation' program, then summarizes the data by summing savings and counting claim IDs. It scores 1 out of 10, meaning it translates directly to SQL with minimal rework. Both tools used - the Filter [3] and Summarize [6] - are simple, well-understood operations with clean SQL equivalents.

key_components.description: Data flows through several steps into the Filter [3], which keeps only records where program equals 'Care Navigation'.
The Summarize tool [6] groups the filtered data by program, summing savings and counting claim IDs.
The summarized result is passed downstream to tool [7].
